import requests, re, time
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle

def uget(a): return requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.json",timeout=60).json()
def clustalo(fa):
    base="https://www.ebi.ac.uk/Tools/services/rest/clustalo"
    jid=requests.post(base+"/run",data=dict(email="a.scientist@ebi.ac.uk",sequence=fa,
        stype="protein",outfmt="clustal_num"),timeout=120).text.strip()
    st="RUNNING"
    while st=="RUNNING":
        time.sleep(4); st=requests.get(f"{base}/status/{jid}",timeout=60).text.strip()
    return requests.get(f"{base}/result/{jid}/aln-clustal_num",timeout=120).text
def parse_clustal(txt,names):
    aln={}
    for line in txt.splitlines()[1:]:
        m=re.match(r"^(\S+)\s+([A-Za-z\-]+)\s*\d*$",line)
        if m and m.group(1) in names: aln[m.group(1)]=aln.get(m.group(1),"")+m.group(2)
    return aln

panel={"Q8IVP5":"Hs_FUNDC1","Q9DB70":"Mm_FUNDC1","Gg":"E1BWM5","B1H3B1":"Xt_FUNDC1","Q6DH87":"Dr_FUNDC1",
 "Q9BWH2":"Hs_FUNDC2","P18411":"Sc_FUN14","Q22252":"Cel_FNDC-1","A8WT57":"Cbr_fndc-1",
 "A0A2G5V2J1":"Cni_FUN14","A0A1I7T0Q0":"Ctr_FUN14","A0A8R1HQB4":"Cja_FUN14","A0A8S1EWU7":"Cbo_FUN14",
 "A0A7E4UMM2":"Pre_FUN14","A0A914Y074":"Psu_FUN14","A0A1I7SAN2":"Bxy_FUN14","A0A915DHH3":"Ddi_FUN14",
 "A0A1I8BQP0":"Mha_FUN14","A0A0N4ZS05":"Ptr_FUN14"}
panel.pop("Gg"); panel["E1BWM5"]="Gg_FUNDC1"
seqs={lab:uget(acc)["sequence"]["value"] for acc,lab in panel.items()}
aln=parse_clustal(clustalo("".join(f">{l}\n{s}\n" for l,s in seqs.items())), set(seqs))
i=0; h2c={}
for c,ch in enumerate(aln["Hs_FUNDC1"]):
    if ch!="-": i+=1; h2c[i]=c

order=["Hs_FUNDC1","Mm_FUNDC1","Gg_FUNDC1","Xt_FUNDC1","Dr_FUNDC1","Hs_FUNDC2","Sc_FUN14",
       "Cel_FNDC-1","Cbr_fndc-1","Cni_FUN14","Ctr_FUN14","Cja_FUN14","Cbo_FUN14",
       "Pre_FUN14","Psu_FUN14","Bxy_FUN14","Ddi_FUN14","Ptr_FUN14","Mha_FUN14"]
win=[h2c[p] for p in range(11,25)]
labels=[seqs["Hs_FUNDC1"][p-1]+str(p) for p in range(11,25)]

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(16,8.5))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,2,width_ratios=[2.0,1.0],height_ratios=[1,1],hspace=0.45,wspace=0.22)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[:,0])
for r,lab in enumerate(order):
    for k,c in enumerate(win):
        ch=aln[lab][c]; face="#f5f5f5"; tc="#444"
        if ch=="-": face="#ffffff"
        elif ch in "DE": face="#c94c4c"; tc="white"
        elif ch in "WFY": face="#2f6fb5"; tc="white"
        elif ch in "LIV": face="#6fa96f"; tc="white"
        elif ch in "ST": face="#e8c33c"
        ax.add_patch(Rectangle((k,-r),1,1,facecolor=face,edgecolor="#cccccc",lw=.5))
        if ch!="-": ax.text(k+.5,-r+.5,ch,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=11,color=tc)
cs=win.index(h2c[18]); ce=win.index(h2c[21])
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((cs,-len(order)+1),ce-cs+1,len(order),fill=False,edgecolor="black",lw=2.4))
ax.text(cs+(ce-cs+1)/2,1.25,"FUNDC1 LIR\nY18-E19-V20-L21",ha="center",fontsize=10,fontweight="bold")
ax.set_xlim(-0.2,len(win)+0.2); ax.set_ylim(-len(order)+1,2.2)
ax.set_xticks(np.arange(len(win))+.5); ax.set_xticklabels(labels,rotation=90,fontsize=9)
ax.set_yticks(-np.arange(len(order))+.5); ax.set_yticklabels(order,fontsize=10)
ax.set_title("Clustal Omega alignment at the human FUNDC1 LIR\n"
             "red D/E, blue W/F/Y, green L/I/V, yellow S/T; white = gap",fontsize=11)
ax.set_aspect("equal"); [s.set_visible(False) for s in ax.spines.values()]
ax.tick_params(length=0)
ax.text(len(win)/2,-len(order)+0.2,"12/12 nematode FUN14 proteins: no residue pair matching [W/F/Y]xx[L/I/V]",
        ha="center",fontsize=9.5,style="italic")

# positive control panel
axp=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,1])
ctrl=[("Hs_BNIP3  14-25","LQGSWVELHFSN"),("Hs_BNIP3L/NIX","LNSSWVELPMNS"),("Cel_DCT-1","MSESWVELAPSR")]
for r,(lab,s) in enumerate(ctrl):
    for k,ch in enumerate(s):
        face="#f5f5f5"; tc="#444"
        if ch in "DE": face="#c94c4c"; tc="white"
        elif ch in "WFY": face="#2f6fb5"; tc="white"
        elif ch in "LIV": face="#6fa96f"; tc="white"
        elif ch in "ST": face="#e8c33c"
        axp.add_patch(Rectangle((k,-r),1,1,facecolor=face,edgecolor="#cccccc",lw=.5))
        axp.text(k+.5,-r+.5,ch,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=10,color=tc)
axp.add_patch(Rectangle((4,-2),4,3,fill=False,edgecolor="black",lw=2.2))
axp.set_xlim(-.2,12.2); axp.set_ylim(-2,1.8); axp.set_aspect("equal")
axp.set_yticks(-np.arange(3)+.5); axp.set_yticklabels([c[0] for c in ctrl],fontsize=9.5)
axp.set_xticks([]); [s.set_visible(False) for s in axp.spines.values()]; axp.tick_params(length=0)
axp.set_title("Positive control: the same pipeline recovers a\nconserved WVEL LIR in C. elegans DCT-1/BNIP3L",fontsize=10)

# null model panel
axn=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
mins=[0,1,2,3]; probs=[0.477,0.210,0.038,0.004]
axn.bar([str(m) for m in mins],probs,color=["#b0b0b0","#d98c2b","#2f6fb5","#1f4e79"])
for x,p in zip(range(4),probs): axn.text(x,p+0.015,f"{p:.3f}",ha="center",fontsize=9)
axn.axhline(0.05,ls="--",c="k",lw=1); axn.text(3.45,0.065,"p=0.05",fontsize=8,ha="right")
axn.set_xlabel("minimum acidic (D/E) residues at positions -4..-1")
axn.set_ylabel("P(>=1 such motif by chance)")
axn.set_title("Chance expectation in a random 36-residue tail\n"
              "(C. elegans amino-acid composition, 20,000 draws)",fontsize=10)
axn.set_ylim(0,0.58)
axn.annotate("FNDC-1 YYVV\n(1 acidic): P=0.21",xy=(1,0.21),xytext=(1.6,0.40),fontsize=9,
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",lw=1))
axn.annotate("FUNDC1 YEVL\n(3 acidic): P=0.004",xy=(3,0.004),xytext=(2.0,0.14),fontsize=9,
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",lw=1))
plt.show()

# artifact tables
pd.DataFrame([
 dict(protein=l, aligned_to_Hs_FUNDC1_Y18EVL21="".join(aln[l][h2c[p]] for p in range(18,22)),
      matches_LIR_consensus=bool(re.fullmatch(r"[WFY]..[LIV]","".join(aln[l][h2c[p]] for p in range(18,22)))))
 for l in order]).to_csv("artifact_LIR_column_mapping.csv",index=False)
print("saved artifact_LIR_column_mapping.csv")
